Evaluations on eight benchmark tasks against seven agent baselines and a TypeSafe Jev variant establish JevSpawn as a promising approach to structured agentic inference, with improved task performance and faster navigation.

ru.title: Быстрые агенты через структурированное вероятностное исследование действий
ru.desc: В статье предлагается JevSpawn — композиционная политика для ускорения работы агентов на основе LLM путём использования вероятностных моделей над конечными множествами действий. Система преобразует естественноязычные инструкции в конкретные наборы возможных действий и адаптирует их через взаимодействие с окружением. Параллельное порождение действий комбинируется с обратной связью для выбора ветвей и восстановления из сохранённых альтернатив. Общая структура действий и префиксы модели уменьшают повторную генерацию, что повышает скорость без дополнительного обучения.

en.title: JevSpawn: Fast and Adaptive Task Solving for LLM Agents
en.desc: This paper presents JevSpawn, a new approach to improve the efficiency of LLM agents in performing tasks based on natural language instructions. Traditional models generate actions slowly and require predefined fields, which limits their adaptability. JevSpawn introduces a compositional policy that allows for fast probabilistic exploration and dynamic action selection based on feedback. The method enhances performance by reducing redundant computations and improving navigation speed across various benchmark tasks.

zh.title: JevSpawn：提升语言模型代理效率的新策略
zh.desc: 本论文介绍了一种名为JevSpawn的组合策略，旨在提高大规模语言模型（LLM）代理的推理和行动效率。JevSpawn通过将自然语言任务规范与有限概率探索相连接，克服了传统模型在任务解决中的局限性。该方法结合了并行行动生成和基于反馈的分支选择，能够在不增加额外训练的情况下减少重复生成和上下文计算。实验结果表明，JevSpawn在八个基准任务上表现优于七个代理基线，展示了其在结构化代理推理中的潜力。

papers.title: When Does Correction Become Repair? Mechanistic Auditing of Internal Interventions in Tool-Using LLMs
papers.abstract: Abstract  Before invoking external tools, an agentic LLM must select among a K-way action space: executing a call, seeking clarification, answering directly, or declining. While internal activation steering can alter these pre-execution decisions, conventional aggregate metrics obscure where altered states land and what collateral damage they inflict. We present SAKIKO, an auditing framework that formalizes representation repair via directional error discovery, router-conditioned intervention, destination-resolved verification, and prospectively frozen statistical licensing. Across seven LLMs on When2Call and MetaTool, channel-keyed interventions induce direction-specific net gains in five models; across three sealed evaluations, none of 59 budget-matched random directions matches calibrated target gain. Crucially, destination auditing shows that behavioral movement does not equal repair: an intervention achieving +55 net gain corrupts over half of the baseline-correct decisions it touches, and promising point estimates on Qwen3-4B and Gemma-2-9B are formally declined due to finite-sample uncertainty. SAKIKO establishes the necessity of outcome-resolved adjudication before claiming internal repair. Code: https://github.com/ruizheliUOA/mechanistic-tool-use-llm.
affiliations: School of Computer Science, University of Birmingham, UK
University of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, China

ru.title: Проверка реального ремонта: когда улучшение метрик обманывает
ru.desc: В работе представлен фреймворк SAKIKO для аудита внутреннего управления поведением больших языковых моделей при выборе инструментов. Авторы разработали метод направленного поиска ошибок и вмешательства в активации нейронов для улучшения решений модели о вызове внешних инструментов. Ключевой вклад заключается в том, что простое улучшение метрик не гарантирует истинное исправление — модель может начать принимать правильные решения в одних случаях, но испортить корректные предсказания в других. Исследование показало, что необходимо тщательное аудирование последствий вмешательств перед тем, как утверждать об успешном исправлении внутреннего представления модели.

en.title: SAKIKO: Ensuring True Improvement in LLM Decision-Making
en.desc: This paper introduces SAKIKO, a framework designed to audit and improve the decision-making processes of large language models (LLMs) when they interact with external tools. It emphasizes the importance of understanding how interventions can lead to both positive and negative outcomes, highlighting that not all behavioral changes indicate true improvement. The framework employs techniques like directional error discovery and destination-resolved verification to ensure that any adjustments made to the model's actions are genuinely beneficial. The findings reveal that while some interventions can yield significant gains, they may also inadvertently harm other decisions, underscoring the need for careful evaluation of model behavior.

zh.title: SAKIKO：确保大型语言模型的决策修复
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种名为SAKIKO的审计框架，用于在调用外部工具之前帮助大型语言模型（LLM）选择最佳行动。该框架通过方向性错误发现、路由器条件干预、目标验证和统计许可等方法，形式化了表示修复的过程。研究表明，尽管某些干预措施在模型中产生了正向收益，但并不意味着所有行为变化都能实现修复，许多干预可能会损害原本正确的决策。SAKIKO强调在声称内部修复之前，必须进行结果导向的裁定。

papers.title: Prefill-Free Cross-Family KV Cache Transfer for Heterogeneous Multi-Agent LLMs
papers.abstract: Abstract  Recent multi-agent LLM systems increasingly combine heterogeneous models for specialized agent roles. However, text-based communication requires each receiver to prefill shared context already processed by the sender. Reusing the sender's key-value (KV) cache avoids this redundancy, but prefill-free transfer across model families must handle differences in tokenization, model depth, and KV representations. To address these issues, we propose HeteroFold, a prefill-free cross-family KV cache transfer method that keeps both the sender and receiver frozen. HeteroFold aligns model structures, maps the sender cache into the receiver space, and calibrates it to preserve receiver behavior. Across six transfer directions, HeteroFold achieves the best cache-transfer performance on all four long-context benchmarks and most short-context settings. It also matches text-based communication on the multi-agent benchmark. At 32K context length, Llama-3.1-8BrightarrowMinistral-3-14B transfer is 10.7times faster than Native Prefill and 1.18--1.47times faster than the state-of-the-art prefill-free baselines, Dense Latent and KV Ridge. These results show that HeteroFold enables efficient cross-family KV reuse without receiver prefill.

ru.title: Быстрый трансфер кэша между разными моделей без переобучения
ru.desc: В статье предлагается HeteroFold — метод безпрефиксного трансфера кэша ключ-значение между различными семействами языковых моделей в мультиагентных системах. Метод решает проблему несовместимости в токенизации, глубине моделей и представлении KV кэша, оставляя обе модели замороженными. HeteroFold выравнивает структуры моделей, трансформирует кэш отправителя в пространство получателя и калибрует его для сохранения поведения. Экспериментальные результаты показывают ускорение в 10.7 раз по сравнению с нативным префиллингом и значительное улучшение по сравнению с существующими методами трансфера KV кэша на бенчмарках с длинным контекстом.

en.title: HeteroFold: Efficient KV Cache Transfer for Multi-Agent LLMs
en.desc: This paper introduces HeteroFold, a method for transferring key-value (KV) caches between different language models without needing to prefill the receiver's context. It addresses challenges like differences in tokenization and model architecture by aligning the structures and calibrating the cache for the receiver. HeteroFold allows for efficient communication between agents by reusing the sender's KV cache, significantly speeding up the process compared to traditional methods. The results demonstrate that HeteroFold outperforms existing techniques in both long and short context scenarios, making it a valuable advancement in multi-agent systems.

zh.title: HeteroFold：高效的跨家族KV缓存重用
zh.desc: 最近的多智能体大语言模型系统越来越多地结合异构模型以实现专业化的代理角色。然而，基于文本的通信要求每个接收者预填充发送者已经处理的共享上下文。重用发送者的关键值（KV）缓存可以避免这种冗余，但跨模型家族的无预填充传输必须处理标记化、模型深度和KV表示的差异。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了HeteroFold，这是一种无预填充的跨家族KV缓存传输方法，能够在保持发送者和接收者不变的情况下，实现高效的缓存传输。

papers.title: Controlled Decoding Attacks on Black-Box LLMs
papers.abstract: Abstract  Manipulating next-token probabilities during generation can bypass the safety alignment of large language models. Existing approaches, however, rely on access to model weights or numerical token probabilities and therefore do not apply to interfaces that return only sampled text. Reconstructing probabilities from sampled outputs offers a possible alternative, but finite sampling produces sparse and noisy estimates, while repeating this process at every generation step incurs substantial query costs. Our empirical observations suggest that large distributional changes along successful jailbreak trajectories are concentrated at a small subset of positions, motivating selective control. We introduce , a framework for jailbreaking through text-only continuation interfaces that permit repeated sampling and assistant-prefix continuation. Sample-Based Distribution Reconstruction combines sampled outputs with a prior over unobserved actions to obtain a usable control signal. Risk-Gated Residual Control uses the evolving response prefix to decide when to reconstruct and modify the distribution, concentrating sampling costs at selected positions. Speculative Multi-Token Execution further amortizes target calls by verifying and accepting draft prefixes that require no intervention. Across four target endpoints and three benchmarks,  achieves the highest mean score most comparisons against baselines.

ru.title: Обход защиты LLM через реконструкцию распределений вероятностей в текстовом интерфейсе
ru.desc: В этой работе исследуется способность манипулировать вероятностями следующего токена во время генерации для обхода механизмов безопасности больших языковых моделей через текстовые интерфейсы. Авторы предлагают框架, который реконструирует распределение вероятностей из сэмплированных выходов, используя приор для ненаблюдаемых действий. Метод использует избирательный контроль на ключевых позициях и спекулятивное выполнение, снижая вычислительные затраты. Экспериментальные результаты на нескольких бенчмарках показывают превосходство предложенного подхода над существующими методами атаки.

en.title: Selective Control for Safer Text Generation
en.desc: This paper addresses the challenge of manipulating next-token probabilities in large language models to bypass safety measures. Traditional methods require access to model weights or token probabilities, which is not feasible for many applications. The authors propose a new framework that reconstructs probabilities from sampled outputs, allowing for selective control over the generation process. Their approach, which includes techniques like Sample-Based Distribution Reconstruction and Risk-Gated Residual Control, demonstrates improved performance in generating desired outputs while minimizing costs associated with repeated sampling.

zh.title: 通过文本续写破解大型语言模型的安全性
zh.desc: 本文探讨了如何在生成过程中操控下一个词的概率，以绕过大型语言模型的安全对齐。现有的方法依赖于模型权重或数值令牌概率，因此不适用于仅返回采样文本的接口。我们提出了一种新的框架，通过文本续写接口进行破解，结合采样输出和未观察到的动作的先验信息，以获得可用的控制信号。实验结果表明，该方法在多个基准测试中表现优异，能够有效降低采样成本并提高生成质量。

papers.title: Learning What to Recall: Adaptive Multi-Cue Episodic Memory for World Models
papers.abstract: Abstract  World models predict future observations from current experience and actions, yet prediction can depend on observations seen far in the past. Episodic memory preserves past observations for later recall; however, as memory accumulates, it raises a fundamental question: which memories are useful for the current prediction, and which available retrieval cues should be trusted to find them? This is challenging because fixed criteria based on recency, pose overlap, or visual similarity can be unreliable across environments and queries. We propose Future-Aware Recall (FAR), a framework that learns episodic recall from future-aware predictive supervision and adaptive multi-cue scoring. During training, FAR measures predictive utility by the conditional log-likelihood of the realized future given recalled context, approximated by negative diffusion prediction loss, and uses it to train a retriever that remains future-blind at inference. The retriever learns cue-specific relevance and automatically determines which available retrieval cues, such as time, pose, vision, and audio, to trust for each query when selecting memories. Across three complementary settings, FAR outperforms hand-designed recall even with the same retrieval cues, automatically adapts which available cues to trust, and recalls the right history as the world changes. Together, these results establish FAR as a flexible, principled approach to episodic memory access in world models.

ru.title: Будущее как учитель: обучение памяти предсказаниями завтра
ru.desc: В работе предложен метод Future-Aware Recall (FAR) для обучения эпизодической памяти в мировых моделях, которые предсказывают будущие наблюдения. Система учится определять, какие прошлые наблюдения полезны для текущего предсказания, используя суперконтрастное обучение на основе условного логарифма правдоподобия реализованного будущего. FAR использует адаптивное мульти-сигнальное оценивание (время, поза, визуальная информация, аудио) и автоматически определяет, каким сигналам доверять при поиске релевантных воспоминаний для каждого запроса. Экспериментальные результаты показывают, что FAR превосходит ручной подход к выбору памяти и адаптируется к изменениям окружающей среды.

en.title: Enhancing Memory Recall with Future Awareness
en.desc: This paper introduces Future-Aware Recall (FAR), a new framework for improving episodic memory in world models. FAR focuses on predicting future observations by effectively recalling relevant past experiences, using a method that adapts to different cues like time and visual context. It learns which memories are most useful for current predictions by evaluating their predictive utility during training, while remaining flexible during inference. The results show that FAR outperforms traditional methods by automatically selecting the most relevant cues for memory retrieval, enhancing the model's ability to adapt to changing environments.

zh.title: 未来感知回忆：灵活的情节记忆访问方法
zh.desc: 本论文提出了一种名为未来感知回忆（FAR）的框架，用于从未来感知的预测监督中学习情节回忆。FAR通过评估回忆上下文的条件对数似然性来衡量预测效用，并利用负扩散预测损失进行训练。该框架能够自动确定在选择记忆时应信任的检索线索，如时间、姿态、视觉和音频。实验结果表明，FAR在多个设置中优于手动设计的回忆方法，能够灵活适应环境变化。

papers.title: It Takes Workflows to Evolve Better Workflows
papers.abstract: Abstract  Tackling complex real-world tasks can exceed the capabilities of a single large language model (LLM), motivating the use of multi-agent workflows that coordinate specialized agents to work together on these tasks. Recent methods train LLMs to construct better workflows from execution outcomes, but they optimize only the workflow generator, while the other agents that build or execute each workflow remain fixed even though every outcome depends on all of them. However, extending training beyond the generator is challenging: the agents are coupled, and a workflow's outcome is a single sparse score that cannot tell which agent causes a failure. We propose FloWright, which leverages the workflow as a harness to optimize workflows. By introducing a hierarchical, structure-aware reward paradigm, FloWright enables one role to self-evolve and two or more roles to co-evolve, with no additional models, labels, or executions. Considering the limitation that workflows are commonly trained and evaluated on data that a single agent can already handle, we further propose DataWright, an adaptive data hardening approach that converts existing datasets into workflow-level tasks with increased difficulty. Across document, slide, chart, code, math, and finance tasks, small open models trained with FloWright achieve improved performance by up to +7.41%, with co-evolving (+5.03%) more roles gaining more than optimizing one of them alone (+2.83%). Our project page: https://xhguo7.github.io/FloWright/.

ru.title: Совместная эволюция агентов в многоагентных рабочих процессах
ru.desc: В работе предлагается FloWright — метод для оптимизации многоагентных систем на основе LLM, где несколько специализированных агентов сотрудничают при решении сложных задач. Авторы вводят иерархическую, структурно-ориентированную систему вознаграждений, которая позволяет одному агенту самоэволюционировать, а двум и более агентам совместно развиваться без дополнительных моделей и размеченных данных. Дополнительно предлагается DataWright — метод адаптивного усложнения данных, который преобразует существующие датасеты в задачи уровня рабочих процессов с повышенной сложностью. Экспериментально показано, что малые модели, обученные с FloWright, достигают улучшения производительности до 7.41%, причём совместная эволюция нескольких агентов (+5.03%) даёт лучший результат, чем оптимизация одного агента (+2.83%).

en.title: Empowering Multi-Agent Workflows for Enhanced Task Performance
en.desc: This paper introduces FloWright, a method for optimizing multi-agent workflows in complex tasks using large language models (LLMs). Unlike previous approaches that only optimize the workflow generator, FloWright allows all agents involved in the workflow to evolve together, improving overall performance. The authors also present DataWright, a technique that enhances existing datasets to create more challenging workflow-level tasks. The results show that small open models trained with FloWright can achieve significant performance improvements across various tasks by enabling agents to co-evolve.

zh.title: 优化多代理工作流，提升任务性能！
zh.desc: 本论文提出了一种名为FloWright的方法，旨在优化多代理工作流，以解决复杂的现实任务。通过引入层次化的奖励机制，FloWright使得不同角色能够自我进化和共同进化，从而提高工作流的整体性能。我们还提出了DataWright，一种自适应数据增强方法，将现有数据集转化为更具挑战性的工作流任务。实验结果表明，使用FloWright训练的小型开放模型在多个任务上性能提升显著，尤其是共同进化的角色表现更佳。

papers.title: Replacing Large Language Models with Jev Decision Models for Low-Latency Edge Service Orchestration
papers.abstract: Abstract  Natural-language service requests can require a language-model decision before execution starts, consuming part of the request's latency budget. We integrate Jev's decision-oriented application programming interface (API) into edge service orchestration to reduce this overhead while retaining service completion. The integration extracts four to eight bounded intent fields and applies a shared validator, admission policy, and scheduler, accounting for decision waiting throughout the request timeline. We compare Jev, two self-hosted decision models, and three hosted large language models (LLMs) on 8,280 verified requests and on a live admission path with modeled execution and a real optical character recognition service. Across 33 test conditions, Jev reduces median decision latency by 22.7-64.5% relative to the fastest LLM. This latency barely moves with input size, contract width, or catalog size. On four-field contracts, Jev's API fees per correct decision are 59.7-80.9% lower at a cost of a few exact-match points, while wide contracts mark the limit of the substitution. Receiving the service catalog with each request, Jev names unseen services as accurately as known ones. On the live admission path, Jev keeps 0.91-0.95 of requests exact and on time at loads where the LLMs fall below 0.1. Since caching repeated descriptions gives the interpreters nearly the same latency, Jev's gain lies in fresh decisions. These results support decision-model substitution for latency-bound admission on bounded contracts.
affiliations: School of Electrical, Mechanical and Biomedical Engineering, University of Technology Sydney, Sydney, Australia

ru.title: Быстрые решения вместо мощных моделей: замена LLM на специализированные системы для минимизации задержек
ru.desc: В работе предлагается интегрировать специализированную модель принятия решений Jev в систему оркестрации сервисов на граничных вычислениях для снижения задержки при обработке естественных языковых запросов. Система извлекает ограниченное количество полей намерения пользователя и применяет валидатор, политику допуска и планировщик, учитывая время ожидания решения в течение всего жизненного цикла запроса. Сравнение Jev с самостоятельно развёрнутыми моделями и облачными LLM на реальных данных показало, что Jev снижает медианную задержку принятия решения на 22.7-64.5% при значительно более низких затратах. Результаты демонстрируют, что специализированные модели могут эффективно заменять универсальные LLM для задач принятия решений с ограниченными контрактами и жёсткими требованиями по времени отклика.

en.title: Jev: Speeding Up Service Requests with Smart Decisions
en.desc: This paper presents Jev, a decision-oriented API designed to enhance the efficiency of natural-language service requests by minimizing latency. By integrating Jev into edge service orchestration, the system can quickly extract intent fields and apply a shared validator and scheduler, which streamlines the decision-making process. The results show that Jev significantly reduces median decision latency by 22.7-64.5% compared to the fastest large language models, while maintaining high accuracy in service naming. Overall, Jev demonstrates a promising approach for improving latency-bound admissions in service requests, especially under varying loads and contract conditions.

zh.title: Jev：提升决策效率，降低延迟的智能API
zh.desc: 这篇论文探讨了如何通过集成Jev的决策导向API来减少自然语言服务请求的延迟。研究表明，Jev能够在保持服务完成的同时，显著降低决策延迟，减少22.7%到64.5%。通过提取意图字段并应用共享验证器和调度器，Jev在处理请求时表现出色。实验结果显示，Jev在高负载情况下的准确性和及时性远超其他大型语言模型。

papers.title: Keyword Harnesses Fail Open: A Cheap Diagnostic Ladder for Tool-Use Claims in Small Language Models
papers.abstract: Abstract  Keyword-matching benchmarks can credit small models for tool use they never perform. We document such a false positive in a matched-architecture pair of Spanish security language models and propose a ladder of strict, cheap diagnostics. A 661.6M parameter model (approx. 65% code/technical text; no dedicated SFT) and a 1,109M model (web-heavy multi-phase curriculum; 6B-token tool-SFT) share decoder, tokenizer, and special tokens, scoring almost identically on lenient tool-use metrics (B4: 0.660 vs. 0.650).   Verbatim-reproduction checks on training examples separate them completely: the 600M emits valid tool calls with generalized arguments on 6/6 examples; the 1B does so on 0/6 across checkpoints. A first-token probe localizes the 1B's failure to a missing prior (prob. 10^{-4}--10^{-5} on <|tool_call|>), which was erased by its web-heavy training phase. A targeted SFT recipe (diverse corpus, 5x higher learning rate, 2,202 steps, ~3.3 GPU-hours) repairs the 1B using three orders of magnitude fewer tokens than the failed phase. On all 269 corpus rows, valid emission rises from 0.100 to 0.959 (600M: 0.926). On 238 unseen prompts, the repaired 1B passes 0.536 vs. the 600M's 0.428 (p = 0.004). Embedding-drift checks show the repair did not move the trigger token's tied embedding (97.7% of the bf16 table remains bit-identical), meaning changes live in the surrounding network.   Both models over-trigger, rarely answering negative prompts without a call (0.09 for 600M, 0.17 for repaired 1B). Factorial analyses confirm all repair configurations install the format, though suppression benefits from a diverse corpus remain a hypothesis due to seed sensitivity. This cheap diagnostic ladder costs minutes of CPU time and should gate tool-use claims on small models.

ru.title: Как поймать подделку: простая диагностика для реального использования инструментов в малых моделях
ru.desc: В статье показано, что стандартные бенчмарки для оценки использования инструментов в языковых моделях могут давать ложноположительные результаты. Авторы сравнили две испанские модели безопасности с одинаковой архитектурой, но разным обучением: меньшая модель (662M параметров) лучше генерирует вызовы инструментов, чем большая (1,1B параметров), хотя стандартные метрики показывают их одинаковыми. Проблема большой модели оказалась в недостающем приоре для токена инструмента, который был стёрт во время обучения на веб-данных. Авторы предложили дешёвый способ исправления через целевую дообучение с адаптированным корпусом и повышенной скоростью обучения, что восстановило функциональность за считанные часы GPU.

en.title: Unmasking Tool Use: Diagnosing and Repairing Language Models
en.desc: This paper discusses the issue of small language models being inaccurately credited for tool use based on keyword-matching benchmarks. The authors compare two models, one with 661.6M parameters and another with 1,109M parameters, which perform similarly on lenient metrics but differ significantly in their ability to generate valid tool calls. They introduce a series of diagnostics to identify and repair the shortcomings of the larger model, which failed to produce valid tool calls due to its training phase. The proposed targeted fine-tuning method significantly improves the larger model's performance while maintaining the integrity of its embeddings, suggesting a more reliable approach to evaluating tool-use capabilities in language models.

zh.title: 小模型工具使用的误导与修复
zh.desc: 这篇论文探讨了关键词匹配基准如何错误地给小模型记功，尽管它们并未真正执行工具使用。研究中比较了两个西班牙安全语言模型，发现661.6M参数的模型在工具使用指标上与1,109M参数的模型几乎相同，但在训练示例的逐字重现检查中却表现截然不同。通过针对性的微调（SFT），研究者成功修复了1B模型，使其在有效工具调用的能力上显著提升。最后，论文提出了一种廉价的诊断方法，建议在小模型的工具使用声明中应用，以避免误导。

papers.title: OTRetarget: Joint Robot and Object Motion Retargeting via Optimal Transport
papers.abstract: Abstract  Transferring human motion to humanoid robots requires adapting the demonstrated motion to the robot morphology while preserving interactions with the environment. This is particularly challenging for loco-manipulation tasks, where contacts with the ground and manipulated objects must remain consistent despite differences in body proportions. Yet, skeletal motion alone does not fully describe these interactions, and fixing object trajectories limits the adaptation to a new embodiment. In this paper, we introduce OTR ETARGET, a unified approach to jointly retarget robot and multi-object motion from human demonstrations. Our approach represents surface interactions through signed distances, closest surface points, and relative directions, and uses entropic optimal transport to transfer these quantities across human, robot, and object geometries. We incorporate the resulting interaction targets into a constrained inverse kinematics formulation that balances contact preservation with motion style and jointly optimizes robot and object poses at each frame. This formulation accommodates robot-object and object-object interactions without rescaling the scene or the demonstration. We validate the proposed approach on OMOMO, where it achieves a robot- object interaction Jaccard score of 87% and a depth error of 8.7 mm, compared with 28% and 29.3 mm for OmniRetarget. Finally, we demonstrate transfer to a physical G1 humanoid using whole-body policies trained with reinforcement learning on the retargeted references, across motions including two-handed box pick-and-place onto a table.

ru.title: Сохранение контактов при адаптации человеческих движений на роботов через оптимальный транспорт
ru.desc: В работе предлагается метод OTR ETARGET для адаптации человеческих движений на гуманоидные роботы с сохранением взаимодействия с окружением. Авторы используют оптимальный транспорт для трансфера информации о контактах между человеком, роботом и объектами через геометрические характеристики, такие как знаковые расстояния и ближайшие точки поверхностей. Предложенный подход интегрирует целевые взаимодействия в формулировку обратной кинематики с ограничениями, которая балансирует сохранение контактов и стиль движения. Метод демонстрирует высокую точность на бенчмарке OMOMO (87% Jaccard score) и успешно применён к физическому роботу G1 для задач манипуляции двумя руками.

en.title: Unified Motion Retargeting for Humanoid Robots
en.desc: This paper presents OTR ETARGET, a method for transferring human motion to humanoid robots while maintaining environmental interactions. It addresses the challenges of loco-manipulation tasks by using signed distances and optimal transport to adapt motion for different robot geometries. The approach incorporates interaction targets into a constrained inverse kinematics framework, ensuring that both robot and object movements are optimized together. The method is validated through experiments, achieving high accuracy in robot-object interactions and demonstrating effective motion transfer to a physical humanoid robot.

zh.title: 人类运动转移到机器人：OTR ETARGET方法
zh.desc: 本论文提出了一种名为OTR ETARGET的方法，用于将人类示范的运动转移到类人机器人上，同时保持与环境的交互。该方法通过有符号距离、最近表面点和相对方向来表示表面交互，并利用熵最优传输技术在人体、机器人和物体几何之间传递这些信息。我们将这些交互目标纳入约束逆向运动学的框架中，平衡接触保持与运动风格，并在每一帧中共同优化机器人和物体的姿态。实验结果表明，该方法在OMOMO平台上取得了87%的机器人-物体交互Jaccard得分，验证了其有效性。

papers.title: Latent-Foresight: End-to-End Learning Predictable Representations for Latent World Models
papers.abstract: Abstract  Predicting the future evolution of a scene is a fundamental capability for world modeling. Recent work has shown that operating in the feature space of Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) yields semantically rich representations that support diverse future scene understanding tasks. However, existing approaches rely on two-stage pipelines, where VFM features are first compressed using fixed dimensionality reduction (e.g., PCA) or independently trained autoencoders, and a separate predictor is trained on top of the resulting frozen latent space. This decoupling between representation learning and temporal prediction, as well as approaches that apply predictors directly on raw VFM features, provides no guarantee that the latent space is structured for predictable dynamics. In this work, we propose Latent-Foresight, an end-to-end framework that jointly learns a latent tokenizer and a flow-based generative dynamics model, explicitly shaping the representation to support temporal predictability. To enable stable joint optimization, we introduce several key design choices that prevent latent collapse and align reconstruction with generative objectives. Extensive experiments show that our approach learns more temporally coherent latent representations and consistently outperforms two-stage baselines across multiple future scene understanding tasks and prediction horizons, while eliminating separate training stages, including during high-resolution adaptation. We provide the implementation code and model weights at https://github.com/Sta8is/Latent-Foresight

ru.title: Совместное обучение представлений для предсказания динамики сцен
ru.desc: Статья предлагает Latent-Foresight — сквозной фреймворк для предсказания будущей эволюции сцен, который совместно обучает токенизатор скрытого пространства и генеративную модель динамики на основе потоков. В отличие от существующих двухэтапных подходов, которые используют фиксированное снижение размерности или отдельно обученные автокодировщики, этот метод явно формирует представление для поддержки временной предсказуемости. Авторы вводят ключевые технические решения, которые предотвращают коллапс скрытого пространства и согласовывают цели реконструкции и генерации. Эксперименты демонстрируют, что подход обучает более темпорально согласованные представления и превосходит двухэтапные базовые методы на различных задачах понимания будущих сцен.

en.title: Latent-Foresight: Predicting the Future with Structured Representations
en.desc: This paper introduces Latent-Foresight, a novel framework for predicting future scenes by learning a structured latent space that enhances temporal predictability. Unlike traditional methods that use separate stages for feature extraction and prediction, Latent-Foresight integrates these processes into a single end-to-end model. It employs a latent tokenizer and a flow-based generative dynamics model to ensure that the learned representations are coherent over time. The results demonstrate that this approach outperforms existing two-stage methods in various future scene understanding tasks, providing a more effective solution for dynamic world modeling.

zh.title: 联合学习，提升场景预测能力
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种名为Latent-Foresight的框架，用于预测场景的未来演变。该框架通过联合学习潜在标记器和基于流的生成动态模型，旨在明确塑造表示以支持时间可预测性。与传统的两阶段方法不同，Latent-Foresight消除了独立训练阶段，能够在高分辨率适应过程中保持稳定的联合优化。实验结果表明，该方法在多个未来场景理解任务中表现优于现有基线，学习到的潜在表示更加时间一致。

papers.title: Before It Fades: Reinforcing Temporal Representations at Inference Time in VideoLLMs
papers.abstract: Abstract  Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) receive frames in sequential order and interpret how visual content evolves along the temporal axis, yet temporal reasoning remains a persistent weakness across architectures. Reversing the frame order of a video, a transformation that should invert temporal answers, often leaves the final prediction unchanged. We investigate where this failure originates by defining the temporal divergence vector τ_l, the layer-wise representational difference induced by reversing temporal order. Tracking its magnitude across layers reveals a consistent temporal divergence profile where the divergence peaks at intermediate layers and progressively diminishes toward the output. We confirm this peak is specific to temporal reasoning and functionally critical for predictions, establishing that VideoLLMs acquire temporal information at intermediate layers but fail to maintain it to the output. This progressive fading motivates our method, Temporal Activation Injection (TAI), which extracts τ_l at the peak of the profile for each input and reinjects it into subsequent layers following the measured decay. TAI requires no training and consistently improves temporal reasoning across three VideoLLMs and four benchmarks with negligible impact on non-temporal tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/Youngwoo-git/Before-It-Fades.
affiliations: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST)

ru.title: Спасение временной информации перед её исчезновением
ru.desc: В статье исследуется проблема слабого временного рассуждения в VideoLLM — больших языковых моделях, обрабатывающих видеофреймы последовательно. Авторы обнаружили, что когда видео воспроизводится в обратном порядке, модели часто дают одинаковые предсказания, несмотря на инвертированную временную информацию. Через анализ слоёв нейронной сети они выявили, что временные представления максимальны на промежуточных слоях, но постепенно исчезают к выходу модели. На основе этого открытия предложена метода Temporal Activation Injection (TAI), которая сохраняет временную информацию путём её переинъекции в последующие слои без необходимости переобучения.

en.title: Enhancing Temporal Reasoning in VideoLLMs with TAI
en.desc: This paper addresses the limitations of Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) in understanding temporal information in videos. It identifies a specific issue where reversing the order of video frames does not change the model's predictions, indicating a weakness in temporal reasoning. The authors introduce the concept of the temporal divergence vector, which measures how well the model retains temporal information across its layers. To improve this retention, they propose a method called Temporal Activation Injection (TAI), which enhances the model's ability to reason about time without requiring additional training.

zh.title: 提升视频模型时间推理的创新方法
zh.desc: 视频大型语言模型（VideoLLMs）在处理视频帧时，能够理解视觉内容如何随时间变化，但在时间推理方面仍然存在不足。研究发现，当视频帧顺序反转时，模型的最终预测往往不变，这表明模型在时间推理上存在缺陷。通过定义时间发散向量τ_l，研究发现这种发散在中间层达到峰值，并在输出层逐渐减弱。为了解决这个问题，提出了一种新的方法——时间激活注入（TAI），该方法能够在不需要训练的情况下，显著提高视频模型的时间推理能力。

papers.title: Pay for the Fault, Not the Flow: Label-Free In-Flow Multi-Agent Workflow Optimization
papers.abstract: Abstract  Large language models (LLMs) increasingly construct multi-agent workflows that decompose a complex task and assign specialist agents from a pool. However, building such a workflow well remains challenging: how finely to divide the task, which agent to trust with each subtask, and when to create a new specialist are all critical decisions a workflow constructor needs to settle up front. Thus, whether each subtask succeeds remains unknown until the workflow runs. Yet, improving a workflow is costly. Locating a fault usually requires a reference answer, a graded outcome, or a trained assessor, and the fix is applied to the whole workflow through re-execution, re-search, or retraining. We propose InFlowOp, which prices every decision in one label-free cost that weighs how well an agent's competence meets what a subtask demands against how much that agent takes to run. Before execution, InFlowOp bidirectionally determines the granularity of task decomposition and agent assignment following from the cost rather than from a fixed template. During execution, InFlowOp corrects a fault with the cheapest move via the same cost that serves the workflow both as it is built and as it runs. Facing the workflow-level evaluation challenge, we introduce Braid, a benchmark whose tasks require multi-agent coordination beyond single-agent capability. Across various domains and backbones, InFlowOp outperforms single agent baselines by up to +11.97%, achieving +9.64% with in-flow optimization. Our project page: https://xhguo7.github.io/InFlowOp/.

ru.title: Самооптимизирующиеся многоагентные рабочие процессы без разметки данных
ru.desc: В статье предлагается метод InFlowOp для автоматической оптимизации многоагентных рабочих процессов, построенных на основе больших языковых моделей. Ключевая инновация заключается в введении единой метрики стоимости без использования размеченных данных, которая оценивает компетентность агента относительно требований подзадачи и вычислительных затрат. Метод работает как на этапе проектирования рабочего процесса (определяя гранулярность декомпозиции задачи и распределение агентов), так и во время выполнения (исправляя ошибки наиболее экономичным способом). Авторы представляют бенчмарк Braid для оценки многоагентной координации, на котором InFlowOp показывает улучшение до 11.97% по сравнению с одноагентными подходами.

en.title: Optimizing Multi-Agent Workflows with InFlowOp
en.desc: This paper introduces InFlowOp, a method for optimizing multi-agent workflows in large language models (LLMs). It addresses the challenges of task decomposition and agent assignment by evaluating the cost-effectiveness of each decision before execution. InFlowOp dynamically adjusts the granularity of tasks and agent roles based on their competence and operational costs. The authors also present Braid, a benchmark for testing multi-agent coordination, demonstrating that InFlowOp significantly improves performance over traditional single-agent approaches.

zh.title: 优化多代理工作流的智能决策
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种名为InFlowOp的方法，用于优化多代理工作流的构建和执行。该方法通过一种无标签的成本评估机制，帮助决策任务的细分和代理的分配，从而提高工作流的效率。InFlowOp在执行过程中能够根据成本动态修正错误，确保工作流的顺利进行。实验结果表明，InFlowOp在多个领域的表现优于单一代理基线，显示出其在多代理协调任务中的优势。

papers.title: DexPolicy: Scheduled Exploration for Trajectory-Guided Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Abstract  Reinforcement learning (RL) for dexterous manipulation must discover finger-object contacts and then control the object precisely; the action noise that serves the first goal can interfere with the second. In trajectory-guided settings such as ViViDex, where RL refine hand-object trajectories from human video, our baseline PPO runs end near their initial action noise after 5M steps, motivating explicit control of exploration scale. DexPolicy makes that scale an explicit function of training steps, annealing from broad to narrow exploration while holding loss, architecture, reward, and optimizer settings fixed. We study three policy-optimization settings: PPO, critic-free GRPO continuation, and a flow-parameterized PPO variant (FPO). Across five YCB objects and three training seeds, mean deterministic Target success rises from 49.4% to 68.1% (FPO), 14.1% to 45.4% (GRPO), and 32.0% to 35.7% (PPO). On a RealMan RM75 arm with an Inspire/RH56 hand, 360 trials over three objects raise mean Target success from 25.0% to 85.0% (FPO), 10.0% to 63.3% (GRPO), and 8.3% to 43.3% (PPO), with one trained model per object-method condition. PPO component screening favors noise control over the tested optimizer contraction; the selected PPO schedule yields higher mean Target success than linear decay with the same endpoints on three tested objects. Training return, deterministic Target success, and tolerance to execution noise dissociate; schedules should therefore be judged by terminal task success under the intended execution conditions, per task and policy-optimization setting. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/DexPolicy. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/DexPolicy.
affiliations: School of Computer Science, Peking University

ru.title: Управление исследованием через контроль шума в ловком манипулировании
ru.desc: В статье предлагается DexPolicy — метод для улучшения обучения с подкреплением в задачах ловкого манипулирования объектами. Авторы решают проблему конфликта между исследованием пространства действий (exploration) и точным управлением объектом, делая масштаб шума явной функцией шагов обучения. Они тестируют три алгоритма оптимизации политики (PPO, GRPO и FPO) и показывают значительное улучшение успешности выполнения задач как в симуляции, так и на реальном робототехническом манипуляторе. Ключевой вывод заключается в том, что расписание контроля шума более важно для финального успеха задачи, чем другие гиперпараметры.

en.title: DexPolicy: Optimizing Exploration for Better Dexterous Manipulation
en.desc: This paper discusses a method called DexPolicy for improving reinforcement learning in dexterous manipulation tasks. It addresses the challenge of balancing exploration and exploitation by adjusting the scale of exploration as training progresses. The authors compare different policy optimization techniques, including PPO and GRPO, and demonstrate that their approach significantly increases the success rate of manipulating objects. The results show that careful control of exploration noise leads to better performance in achieving task goals.

zh.title: 优化探索规模，提高灵巧操作成功率
zh.desc: 本论文探讨了强化学习在灵巧操作中的应用，特别是如何在控制物体时处理手指与物体的接触。研究提出了一种名为DexPolicy的方法，通过调整探索规模来提高学习效果，从而在训练过程中实现更精确的控制。实验结果显示，使用不同的策略优化方法（如PPO和GRPO）可以显著提高目标成功率。最终，研究强调了在特定执行条件下评估训练效果的重要性。

papers.title: Predictive Credit: Measuring What Scientific Explanations Add to Experimental Forecasts
papers.abstract: Abstract  Research agents explain planned experiments. We measure predictive credit with paired forecasts sharing an intervention, forecaster, and outcome while varying description, matched explanation, and donor context. Five checks track commitment, delivery, predictive gain, alignment, and known-signal uptake. Across 336 prospective states in controlled learning, 12 Tox21 endpoints, and 24 OpenML tasks, v5's frozen credit decision was inconclusive. Tox21's preregistered ROC AUC interval-score harm test was unmet (D-M=-.0026, 95 percent interval [-.0174, .0104]); OpenML's joint formation, point-equivalence, and repeatability rule was unmet. Matched point-accuracy gains over description remained unconfirmed, and Tox21/OpenML seed-donor intervals spanned zero. Under requested DeepSeek V4 Pro, matched and donor cards reduced secondary Tox21 drift by 64.5 and 59.1 percent. A DeepSeek V4 Flash replay raised matched point MAE from .01823 to .02020 and missed matched-donor interval-score equivalence. OpenML full-card assignment widened nominal 80 percent intervals by 21 percent, with 49.3 percent coverage versus 51.4 percent for description and content in 66/144 cards. Direct-text Flash delivered all 144 notes without detectable matched point-accuracy gain. A researcher-authored mechanism positive control lowered point MAE by 2.60 percentage points versus description. The protocol measures predictive credit for research-agent benchmarks and scientific forecasting; natural-explanation credit remained unconfirmed at the tested donor resolutions.

ru.title: Объяснения агентов не гарантируют улучшение предсказаний моделей
ru.desc: В этой работе исследователи оценивают, насколько объяснения экспериментов, предоставленные исследовательскими агентами, улучшают предсказательную способность моделей. Авторы проводят систематическое тестирование на трёх наборах данных (336 проспективных состояний, 12 эндпоинтов Tox21 и 24 задач OpenML), измеряя влияние различных типов описаний и контекста на точность предсказаний. Результаты показывают смешанные результаты: хотя некоторые методы снижали дрейф модели на Tox21 (на 64.5% и 59.1%), основные гипотезы о преимуществах объяснений не подтвердились статистически значимо. Авторы разработали протокол оценки предсказательного выигрыша от естественных объяснений для научного прогнозирования и бенчмарков с участием исследовательских агентов.

en.title: Exploring Predictive Credit in Research Agents' Experiments
en.desc: This paper investigates how research agents can explain their planned experiments and measure the effectiveness of their predictions. It uses paired forecasts to analyze various factors like description and context while tracking metrics such as predictive gain and alignment. The results from multiple tasks showed inconclusive outcomes regarding the predictive credit of the agents, with some tests failing to meet established benchmarks. Overall, the study highlights the challenges in confirming predictive accuracy and the need for better mechanisms in scientific forecasting.

zh.title: 研究代理的预测信用与实验解释
zh.desc: 本研究探讨了研究代理如何解释计划的实验。我们通过配对预测来衡量预测信用，这些预测共享干预、预测者和结果，同时变化描述、匹配解释和捐赠者背景。研究结果显示，在336个前瞻性状态和多个任务中，预测信用的决策并不明确，且未能满足预注册的ROC AUC区间分数测试。尽管在某些情况下，匹配和捐赠卡减少了Tox21的漂移，但整体的预测准确性提升仍未得到确认。

papers.title: Honeycomb: Constant-Size Scene Memory Representation for Video World Models
papers.abstract: Abstract  Video world models require persistent scene memory to maintain consistency during long-horizon video generation. Existing spatial memories accumulate RGB observations or latent features, increasing storage requirements as generation proceeds. We introduce Honeycomb, a video world model built on HexMemory, our proposed low-rank representation for storing scene features in a fixed-size memory with a total of six spatial and spatiotemporal planes. A feed-forward writer maps each generated chunk into new plane features. As the spatial coverage or temporal range expands, we warp the previous planes while preserving their dimensions, then fuse them with the new features through confidence-weighted pooling and a learned residual correction. A reader retrieves latents from HexMemory to condition subsequent video generation. The writer processes only observations from the new chunk, avoiding per-scene optimization and repeated processing of the full history. Experiments on WorldScore and RealEstate10K demonstrate strong video generation quality and robust revisit consistency while keeping HexMemory feature storage constant throughout generation. Code and additional visualizations are available on our project page at https://jackswl.github.io/honeycomb/.

ru.title: Компактная память для видеогенерации через низкоранговое представление
ru.desc: В работе предлагается Honeycomb — видео world model, использующая HexMemory для компактного хранения информации о сцене в памяти фиксированного размера с помощью шести пространственных и пространственно-временных плоскостей. Модель содержит два компонента: writer, который преобразует каждый новый видеофрагмент в признаки плоскостей, и reader, который извлекает латентные представления для генерации следующих кадров. По мере расширения пространственного охвата или временного диапазона предыдущие плоскости искажаются с сохранением размерности, а затем объединяются с новыми признаками через взвешенное по уверенности объединение и изученную остаточную коррекцию. Экспериментальные результаты на наборах данных WorldScore и RealEstate10K показывают высокое качество видеогенерации и стабильность сцены при постоянном объёме памяти HexMemory.

en.title: Efficient Video Generation with Fixed-Size Memory
en.desc: This paper presents Honeycomb, a video world model that utilizes HexMemory, a low-rank representation for efficient scene feature storage. Unlike traditional methods that require increasing memory as video generation progresses, Honeycomb maintains a fixed-size memory with six spatial and spatiotemporal planes. The model employs a feed-forward writer to map new video chunks into these planes while using confidence-weighted pooling to integrate past and present features. Experiments show that Honeycomb achieves high-quality video generation and consistent scene revisits without the need for extensive memory expansion.

zh.title: Honeycomb：高效的视频世界模型
zh.desc: 本论文介绍了一种名为Honeycomb的视频世界模型，它使用HexMemory来存储场景特征，从而在固定大小的内存中保持一致性。与传统方法不同，Honeycomb通过低秩表示减少了存储需求，避免了随着生成过程的进行而增加的存储负担。该模型通过一个前馈写入器将生成的片段映射到新的特征平面，并通过信心加权池化和学习的残差校正来融合新特征。实验结果表明，Honeycomb在视频生成质量和重访一致性方面表现出色，同时保持了HexMemory特征存储的恒定。
